info.title: History of Market — data API
info.summary: Read-only JSON datasets behind every chart on historyofmarket.com.
info.description: Every chart on the site is drawn from a static JSON file under /api/. The files are regenerated after each U.S. trading day by a scheduled job and served from the CDN edge; there is no auth, no rate limit, no parameters and no write surface. Paths carry a mandatory `.json` suffix. A miss under /api/ returns HTTP 404 with a JSON body (`{error: {code, status, message, hint, resolution[]}}`), never HTML. Start with /api/_manifest.json (what exists and when it changed) or /api/profile.json (which dataset answers which question). Reuse with attribution is welcome; copying the work is not. Data (/api/**.json): CC BY 4.0. Charts, share images, embeds and quotes: free to reuse when credited "History of Market (historyofmarket.com)" with a link. No derivative or look-alike sites, no use of the brand names, no citation without the source. Terms: https://historyofmarket.com/license/

example.context_cn: 读者要记住的一件事:这条边界是会动的,所以任何跨 2023-03-17 的板块长序列都带着一个口径接缝。我们不把两段拼接、也不回溯重算——XLP 与 XLY 的历史曲线画的是各自当时的口径,这张卡片就是那道接缝的说明。三家搬家公司合计约占 XLY 迁出前权重的个位数百分比,但它们把必需消费的零售一侧从「超市 + 会员店」扩成了「超市 + 会员店 + 折扣百货」。

Dataset.description: Generic fallback. Each operation references its own schema, `Dataset_<key>`, inferred from the published file (first ~50 items of each array; `required` = keys present in every sampled item; nesting capped at 4). Panel payloads differ per dataset; most carry an `updated` ISO date plus a `series` (daily `{date, close, …}`) or `years` (annual `{year, ret, …}`) array and a `source` block naming provenance and method. Treat unknown keys as data, not errors.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last successful refresh of this dataset.

source.description: Provenance: `method` (how the number is computed), `constituents` (universe), upstream publisher names.

hint.description: What was probably wrong with the request (e.g. missing `.json`).

NotFound.description: No dataset at this path. Body is JSON with recovery links; the `.json` suffix is the usual omission.

ETag.description: Strong validator; send it back as `If-None-Match` to get 304.
